connector.none: no captured Google Calendar connector; the Claude side serves the same Calendar API responses through its HTTP mock

reads.note: Google Calendar v1.3 event getAll, limit 5: GET /calendar/v3/calendars/user%40example.com/events?timeMin=now+1h&timeMax=now+1h1m&maxResults=5 (singleEvents depends on the recurring-event option, so no query is required). The calendar id is the template's placeholder and is served as is

connector.none: no captured Telegram connector; http with the bot token

writeReplies.note: Telegram sendMessage, one per event; the reply text is model-written

branches: no IF/Switch; Already sent? (remove items seen in previous executions, by event id) passes every event on a first run: its stored history is empty on both sides
the prompt renders start.dateTime and creator.email empty for the all-day event; end.dateTime of null is expected to fail the second item's prompt expression
expect.offline: Schedule Trigger is disabled in the template (no enabled trigger), so the run needs an overlay that enables it; Send reminder posts to chat id CHAT_ID, the template's placeholder (the real API would answer 400 chat not found), so the mock answers it as a sent message
